how_to_change: Change a rule or add an override by a reviewed pull request that edits this file, then regenerate etl/04_integration (python -m src.integration.hdx_adm3_psgc sql|gate). tests/test_integration_hdx.py fails until the files match.

source.note: One map row per HDX ADM3 feature of the published Silver table; none is dropped.

psgc.version_rule: Match only against the master quarter (is_master_reference = TRUE in psa_psgc_clean, today 2026-Q2). When the master quarter changes, the map is rebuilt and the gate's records show what moved.

order: override: a reviewed entry below, applied before every rule
code: the P-code's digits, padded to ten, are a PSGC city or municipality code, and the names agree
correspondence_code: the old 9-digit form of that code equals the unit's PSGC Correspondence Code, and the names agree (D-030)
code_region_moved: the code starts with region 19 and the same code under region 09 exists (Sulu), and the names agree

name in province: the name matches exactly one city or municipality inside the PSGC province found for adm2_pcode (by code, else by Correspondence Code); a feature whose province is not found is not name-matched at all and stays unmatched until an override places it

code with another name: a code rule found a unit but the names differ and no name in the province matched: ambiguous, no psgc_code, review_status pending, until an override confirms it as code_renamed
unmatched: nothing above applies; ambiguous: the best name tier matched two or more units
name_tiers: exact: upper case, spaces collapsed, a trailing (Capital) dropped, 'City of X' read as 'X City'
old name: the same against PSGC old_names
folded: accents and the punctuation . - ' dropped
word City ignored: the words CITY and OF dropped
rules.finding: #74 (analysis/cross_source/cross_source_hdx_boundaries.py, HB-2): 1,634 of 1,642 one-to-one; a code counts only if the names agree, because COD-AB reuses some PSGC code numbers for different units (16 in Maguindanao).

overrides.reason: renamed LGU: COD-AB Bacungan (Leon T. Postigo) is PSGC Leon T. Postigo, Zamboanga del Norte
overrides.evidence: Same code in both sources and the same province; COD-AB keeps the old name Bacungan and gives the current name in brackets. The same unit is a reviewed alias in the CMCI match (#8, analysis/cross_source/cross_source_dti_cmci.py). First local run of the map, #93.

overrides.reason: renamed LGU: COD-AB Don Victoriano Chiongbian (Don Mariano Marcos) is PSGC Don Victoriano, Misamis Occidental
overrides.evidence: Same code in both sources and the same province; COD-AB gives the old name Don Mariano Marcos in brackets; PSGC shortens the current name to Don Victoriano; the PSA population workbook pairs its barangays with Don Victoriano at equal population (BP-4). The same unit is a reviewed alias in the CMCI match (#8, analysis/cross_source/cross_source_dti_cmci.py). First local run of the map, #93.

overrides.reason: renamed LGU: COD-AB San Isidro is PSGC Sawata, Davao del Norte
overrides.evidence: Same code in both sources and the same province; the same municipality under its other name; the PSA population workbook pairs its barangays with Sawata at equal population (BP-4, docs/data/cross-source/coverage.md). The same unit is a reviewed alias in the CMCI match (#8, analysis/cross_source/cross_source_dti_cmci.py). First local run of the map, #93.

overrides.reason: renamed LGU: COD-AB Rizal (Marcos) is PSGC Dr. Jose P. Rizal, Palawan
overrides.evidence: Same code in both sources and the same province; COD-AB gives the old name Marcos in brackets; PSGC uses the full name Dr. Jose P. Rizal. The same unit is a reviewed alias in the CMCI match (#8, analysis/cross_source/cross_source_dti_cmci.py). First local run of the map, #93.

overrides_note: Each override: {"adm3_pcode", "source_reference_date" (the HDX release it was reviewed for; it applies to that release only, so a new COD-AB release brings the feature back to review), "psgc_code" (null for a feature reviewed as unmatched), "match_method" (one of D-029's; null when psgc_code is null), "reason", "evidence"}.
